description: This file defines a PHP class 'WorkWeekAPI' in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the Leave API plugin. It provides endpoints to get and update work week configurations associated with leave management, including retrieving work week data and modifying daily work hours/days. It uses OpenAPI annotations for documentation and implements API methods with validation rules.
